original_3d_reference.name: Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP — United Male reference body
original_3d_reference.underlying_anatomical_imaging: Visible Human Male dataset, US National Library of Medicine
original_3d_reference.license_statement: Human Reference Atlas official 3D Reference Object Library: all reference objects released under Attribution 4.0 International.
original_3d_reference.suggested_credit: Human Reference Atlas (HuBMAP), United Male v1.10, based on the Visible Human Male dataset (US National Library of Medicine).
original_3d_reference.citation_review_note: Verify the named creators and precise citation metadata of the exact united-male/v1.10 digital object before distributing derived chunks.

existing_poly_processing: Selection and reduction of the HRA reference geometry for the web viewer; this is an adapted model, not raw unaltered HRA files.
Packing the selected/processed structures into 918 reference meshes within compressed binary and metadata files.
new_chunk_processing: Lossless byte-exact repacking of existing POLY geometry, preserving original mesh identities and source offset metadata.
New gzip chunk files, independent SHA256 checks and explicit per-chunk manifest.
scientific_non_claims: No clinical or physiological simulation certified
No human-subject-specific neural or tissue state inferred

required_before_distribution: Verify exact United Male v1.10 creator names, recommended citation and source attribution metadata.
Show original source link, CC BY 4.0 link and a change notice in the published viewer and each export of the resulting model.
Review licence scope for any other model layers bundled with the source dataset, if separately governed.
Pin the verified source license/citation manifest to the release and review owner approval.
Ensure no misleading inference of HRA or NLM endorsement.
